name: Vertiv PowerDirect 5000 800 VDC sidecar (pre-release)
description: 800 VDC sidecar beside the IT rack, part of Vertiv's 800 VDC portfolio (centralized rectifiers, DC busway, rack DC-DC, DC backup) slated for H2 2026 commercialization with customer pilots and ramp through 2027. No datasheet yet.

capacity_w.note: Vertiv blog: 'an 800 VDC sidecar, delivering from 400 kW up to 900 kW'; pre-release, no datasheet

efficiency.note: no Vertiv figure. Assumed equal to peer 800 VDC rectifier racks (Delta: AC-DC up to 98%), lower bound allowing for partial-load and BBU losses
